edits.before: The matchup turns at 6 when you steal Demacian Justice: he loses his kill threat, you gain an AP-scaling true-damage execute, and that swings the all-in math enough to force a fight. Use Hijack immediately when he is below 50% HP so the true-damage execute value is maximal. Outside that spike, levels 4-5 are still Garen-favoured — Courage's damage reduction eats your burst window, so trade only when it is provably on cooldown. Count the 24-second timer aloud if needed. Farm and look for jungle assistance rather than forcing solo all-ins on a healthy Garen with Courage available.
edits.after: At 6 you steal Demacian Justice and gain a true-damage execute, but his own R returns on 120s at rank 1 and the duel stays his: cast the stolen R only when he is already low enough that it finishes him. Levels 4-5 are Garen-favoured — Courage is 22s at rank 1 and its shield, tenacity and lingering damage reduction eat your burst window, so trade only when it is provably down. Farm and look for jungle assistance rather than forcing solo all-ins on a healthy Garen with Courage available.
